item.title: Tochoji Temple and the Great Wooden Buddha — Guide
item.description: Tochoji is one of the oldest and most important temples in Fukuoka, founded by the great monk Kobo Daishi (Kukai) in the ninth century, making it central to Shingon Buddhism in the region. In the heart of Hakata, its grounds hold a striking vermilion five-storey pagoda and its greatest treasure: the Fukuoka Daibutsu, a magnificent seated wooden Buddha over 10 metres tall and one of the largest of its kind in Japan, carved from a single camphor tree.
